name: GoHighLevel
description: All-in-one CRM and marketing platform with a marketplace OAuth API and v3 docs.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant via marketplace apps; token endpoint also lists refresh_token and client_credentials grants. Access tokens are Bearer.
gate_detail: Developers register an OAuth app in the marketplace and generate client ID and secret themselves. Sources do not state plan, fee or review requirements.
api_scope: APIs cover contacts, conversations, calendars, workflows, payments and webhooks; an MCP server exposes over 700 actions across 38 features.
mcp_notes: HighLevel MCP Server, also called LeadConnector MCP Server, connects via OAuth; no URL shown in sources.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment blocker is stated, but plan requirements for creating apps are not established.
